schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel to or from areas poorly served by public transport?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في التنقل من وإلى مناطق تخدمها وسائل النقل العام بشكل ضعيف؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, in Gegenden zu fahren oder aus Gegenden zu kommen, die schlecht mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erschlossen sind?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel to or from areas poorly served by public transport?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که به مناطقی که حمل‌ونقل عمومی ضعیفی دارند بروید یا از آنجا برگردید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de aller vers ou revenir de zones mal desservies par les transports en commun ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy a tömegközlekedéssel rosszul ellátott területekre vagy onnan utazni?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a andare o tornare da zone poco servite dai mezzi pubblici?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, toplu taşımanın yetersiz olduğu bölgelere veya bölgelerden yolculuk etmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
